status: UNSIGNED: no signature exists for this receipt
bytes_to_sign: output-hashes.sha256 (exactly the file's bytes; its SHA-256 is output_hashes_sha256)
sign_command: ssh-keygen -Y sign -f <dedicated Ed25519 key, held outside this repository> -n assurance-lab-receipt output-hashes.sha256
verify_command: ssh-keygen -Y verify -f <allowed_signers> -I <signer identity> -n assurance-lab-receipt -s output-hashes.sha256.sig < output-hashes.sha256
